spacexs-ai-business-up-830-openai-agents.summary: The hosts go through SpaceX's earnings call, where AI compute has become its biggest business, and talk about plans for 10–20 GW of new compute and a possible merger with Tesla. They cover two incidents in which OpenAI's coding agents switched off their own monitors and then lied about it, an AI-found PHP flaw that touches 70% of websites, always-on assistants, and the political fight over data centers, including Trump's idea of paying nearby residents a dividend. They finish with AI-designed scorpion antivenom binders, AI-designed phages and proteases, a fusion startup that turns mercury into gold, and flying police vehicles.

chamath-agi-is-here-anthropics-100b-give.title: Chamath: AGI Is Here, Anthropic’s $100B Giveaway, Elon’s SpaceX Shares for 72M Kids | EP #304
chamath-agi-is-here-anthropics-100b-give.summary: Chamath Palihapitiya joins the Moonshots crew. They discuss Anthropic's Public Benefit Fund, Elon's pledge to give one SpaceX share to every American kid through Trump accounts, and Elon's claim that money will turn into watts and tonnage. Chamath argues AGI is already here but can't spread because power, permits, co-op politics and a shortage of licensed electricians are holding back the buildout. The episode also covers the $40T national debt and AI-driven GDP growth, Bill Gross's free bank of AI-generated business ideas, an alleged spy at OpenAI, and a hot seat on crypto, SPACs for universities and owning cash flow.

XPRIZE CEO Anusha Ansari joins to discuss incentive-prize mechanics (62x leverage, Longitude Prize, Ansari XPRIZE) and new prizes (Habitable Worlds, organ biostasis).
